{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows
types_before = sales.dtypes
print("Data types before cleaning:")
print(types_before)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of customer_age == -1:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:")
print(sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order examples:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])"}
